schema.order: 1 = main event, then down the card. Bouts with segment "unknown" are not slotted yet and follow in source order.
schema.title: true only for UFC championship bouts; "belt" names the belt (the BMF belt has title=false)
schema.status: official = on the ESPN fightcenter feed (fed by the UFC) or announced by the UFC itself, and listed by at least two outlets; reported = booked per at least two outlets (or one outlet plus the fighter's own confirmation) but not yet on a UFC-fed listing; rumoured = single-origin report, absent from current card lists; doubtful = sources conflict on whether the bout is still on
schema.slug: key in data/derived/fighters.json, or null for a UFC debut (not in the roster)
schema.prior_ufc_meetings: earlier UFC bouts between the pair, from data/raw/ufc_fight_results.csv (OUTCOME is W/L for the first-named fighter in "bout")
schema.open_slots: a fighter is still booked but has no opponent (nothing to predict yet)
schema.removed: pairings that were announced or reported and are now off, kept for the audit trail
